flags.title: Size it — don't fall in love
flags.note: Even a clean BUY deserves a position cap and an exit plan. Concentrated conviction (loyalty to one name) is how good theses become big drawdowns.
flags.lesson: Amazon: a great company held with no diversification became the biggest single loss.

opportunities.point: The company expects capacity utilization to reach 90% plus across all three segments, including oil, this year.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "we are expecting this year, all our capacity utilization will be up to 90% plus in all the three segments, including oil." (concall transcript - 2025-06-01)

opportunities.point: Management intends to maintain the growth commitments made in previous investor meetings.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "the growth driver will be -- we will maintain as per in our last conversation what we committed in this investor's meet." (concall transcript - 2025-06-01)

opportunities.point: The company launched a new oil production plant and the Poushtik e-commerce division in 2025.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "And most recently in 2025, we launched our new oil production plant, introduced a new vertical called Poushtik which focuses on nutritious rich food products aligned with our mission to bring health and tasty together." (concall transcript - 2025-06-01)

opportunities.point: The new oil plant is an automated, export-oriented unit located in Telangana.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "It is a premium unit completely based out of export oriented unit. So, our focus is on all the oils which are into the double filter or cold press." (concall transcript - 2025-06-01)

opportunities.point: Expectations baked into the price are low, so little has to go right.
P/E is cheaper than the sector median.
P/B is cheaper than the sector median.
Rising institutional interest can keep supporting the price.
opportunities.evidence: POSITIVE MONEY FLOW - institutional holding change 0.2 pp

opportunities.point: Management observes a shift in the spices and atta markets from unorganized to organized trade.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "As I said, one important thing is in the spices, still 70% is an unorganized trade. So, after the post COVID, now people are moving to the packaging and quality products." (concall transcript - 2025-06-01)

opportunities.point: The company is targeting a premium customer base through its Poushtik platform rather than competing on discounts.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "We are focusing just only on the quality and we will advertise or in media wherever then, we will focus on the quality. We are not discount store." (concall transcript - 2025-06-01)

opportunities.point: The installed capacity for spices and masalas is 3,600 tons per annum, with 2,637 tons utilized.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "For spices and masalas, we have an installed capacity of 3,600 tons per annum with the current utilization at about 2,637 tons." (concall transcript - 2025-06-01)

threats.point: The business consumed cash from operations in the latest year.
Profit is growing while operating cash flow is shrinking - an earnings-quality gap.
threats.evidence: Net profit 10 -> 16 Cr (Mar 2026) but operating cash flow -2 Cr (Mar 2025) -> -14 Cr (Mar 2026)

threats.point: The stock has a history of very deep drawdowns.
A fast-growing debt load raises the stakes on execution.
Promoter selling is a warning about insider conviction.
A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
The cost of the oil unit setup increased due to higher-than-expected investment in infrastructure and civil work.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "delay was because of we have invested more into this infrastructure as it is a civil work was huge in this setup plant. So, it was increased by INR1 crores to INR1.5 crores of this as we expected in this." (concall transcript - 2025-06-01)

threats.point: Small size brings liquidity and volatility risk.
Historically weak quarters (Mar) are still in the cycle.

swot.verdict: No quadrant dominates - strengths, opportunities carry equal weight (S29/W21/O29/T21), so the evidence does not favour one side.
